prologue: A Blight is spreading: plausible but false knowledge that grows whenever nobody checks it. It seeps through careless copy-and-paste, unreviewed output, and answers nobody understood. The tools are not the enemy. Walk the land, recruit companions, build your immunity, and clear the Murk.

quests.title: Name the Fears
quests.story: The fire at Basecamp burns low. Around it sit the worries every traveller brings. Name each one, and it shrinks.
quests.done: Each fear has a name and a counter-habit. You travel knowing what you are guarding against.

quests.title: Three Kinds of Machine
quests.story: A workbench holds three machines: one that always repeats, one trained for a single task, one that talks.
quests.done: You can choose the right machine, and sometimes the right machine is a plain script.

quests.title: Know Your Gear
quests.story: The quartermaster lays out the kit: a companion, its armour, and a pile of fittings no one has labelled.
quests.done: You can tell model from harness, and name what each fitting does and does not guarantee.

quests.title: Tokens, Not Letters
quests.story: A mill grinds text into small chunks before the machine reads a word. It never sees the letters you see.
quests.done: You know the machine reads chunks, so counting letters and reading sequences exactly are jobs for a script.

quests.title: Where Machines Fail
quests.story: A sign over the mill door lists what the machine does well and what it only seems to do well. Counting letters is on the second list.
quests.done: You send summaries and drafts to the machine, and counting and calculation to a script, and you spot-check what comes back.

quests.title: The Context Window
quests.story: A great hopper holds everything the machine can see at once. When it overflows, the oldest grain spills out.
quests.done: You know what fills the window, what happens when it is full, and when to start fresh.

quests.title: Memory, Sessions and Usage
quests.story: The mill keeps three ledgers: what it remembers between visits, what it holds during one visit, and what the visit costs. A wrong entry in the first two is hard to erase.
quests.done: You know memory from session context, what burns your usage, and how to clear a context that has gone wrong.

quests.title: When to Start Fresh
quests.story: The hopper is filling. A good miller knows the signs that it is time to empty it, and the signs that emptying it would waste the day.
quests.done: You know the signals for a fresh session, the signals to carry on, and how to compact when you want to keep going.

quests.title: The Stream of Ideas
quests.story: Ideas keep arriving mid-task: what about this, could we also try that. A single stream floods the hopper. The mill has side channels for them.
quests.done: You park, branch or hand off a side idea so the main task stays clear, and you do not lose the idea.

quests.title: Handoff Notes
quests.story: A fresh session knows nothing about your task except what loads automatically or is written down.
quests.done: You can write a handoff note a fresh session can act on, and you know which facts belong in memory, in a note, or in git.

quests.title: Who Said What
quests.story: Three voices speak in the mill: the one that built it, the one you wrote down, and yours. Only one of them is you.
quests.done: You can tell the system prompt, the instructions file and your own message apart, and know which you control.

quests.title: Too Many Tools, Too Many Agents
quests.story: The mill wall is hung with every tool anyone ever made. A craftsman picks three. A chain of agents is rarely needed.
quests.done: You keep the toolset small and reach for an agent only when a plain script or a single call will not do.

quests.title: RAG and Its Cousins
quests.story: Travellers ask the miller about books that never fit the hopper. Some fetch a few pages, some draw a web of names, some say to fetch nothing at all.
quests.done: You can tell the main kinds of RAG apart, and you know when to retrieve, when to paste everything, and when to query or search instead.

quests.title: Grow a Graph with Ollama
quests.story: In a back room the miller strings yarn between pegs: one peg per name, one thread per link. It takes a long time, and every knot is worth checking.
quests.done: You have built and read a small knowledge graph with a local model, and you know what LightRAG and GraphRAG ask of one.

quests.title: Keep a Living Wiki
quests.story: A scribe in the mill keeps a ledger that tidies itself. Each new sack of papers is read once, and every page it touches is updated and cross-linked before the scribe sleeps.
quests.done: You can describe the three layers and three jobs of an agent-kept wiki, you have matched it to a use of your own, and you know where it can mislead you.

quests.title: Recruit the Beast
quests.story: A great armoured beast sleeps in the Kennel, strong but unthinking. It will only follow someone who can set it up and keep it on a short lead.
quests.done: The Beast stirs and falls in beside you. It is powerful and will do exactly what its permissions allow.

quests.title: Adopt the Pet
quests.story: In a corner, a small pet blinks at you. It lives on your own machine, costs nothing to feed, and forgets things easily.
quests.done: The Pet curls up on your laptop. Small and local, it needs more room to think and a leash of its own.

quests.title: Free Is Not Free
quests.story: Stalls outside the Kennel hand out meat for free. Some is fresh, some is a trial, and one stall will not say where it came from. The keeper asks you to read the label before you feed anything.
quests.done: You can name what a free model offer costs, sort it into one of four kinds, and decide which data may go to it.

quests.title: Pick Your Companion
quests.story: The Kennel keeps companions of every size. A big one is slow and costly to feed; a small one is quick and cheap but loses the trail. You must choose per job, and decide how hard each should think.
quests.done: You choose a model and effort for each job, delegate bulk reading to a cheaper helper, and measure before you commit.

quests.title: Claude in the Cloud
quests.story: A tower stands far from the Kennel where the Beast works on a borrowed machine that vanishes when it is done. It is fine for sketching and writing. Nothing precious should ever be carried there.
quests.done: You send scripts and documents to the cloud, keep data and analysis at home, and know what leaves your machine when you do.

quests.title: Save Point
quests.story: The Crypt door is sealed with Murk. A faded note reads: nothing here is safe to touch without a way back.
quests.done: The first seal cracks. You have a save point: any change can now be reversed.

quests.title: Grow the Carapace
quests.story: Deeper in the Crypt, bare skin is not enough. You must grow a carapace: rules about what your companions may touch.
quests.done: A carapace hardens over you. Your companions can now only do what your rules allow.

quests.title: The Locked Cabinet
quests.story: In the deepest chamber lie sealed relics: keys, tokens and samples under special agreements. Not everything here may leave the room.
quests.done: Your visor closes. Keys and sensitive ground stay out of reach, and you know where the agreement lives.

quests.title: Spot the Mirage
quests.story: The maze walls shimmer. Some corridors are real and some are Mirages: things that look exactly right and do not exist.
quests.done: You can name the Mirage's tricks: invented functions, fake citations, confident nonsense.

quests.title: Ground Truth
quests.story: A glowing script claims to have been tested. Only an independent measurement can say whether it is telling the truth.
quests.done: You hold a lantern of ground truth: an independent check that does not trust the agent's word.

quests.title: Boss: The Wall of Output
quests.story: At the maze's heart rises a wall of text, thousands of lines high. It does not attack. It simply cannot be reviewed.
quests.done: The Wall crumbles into small, reviewable stones. You never had to read all of it, only to refuse it whole.

quests.title: Write the Brief
quests.story: The first branch of the great tree is bare. A vague instruction leaves the sap to wander; a clear one makes the bark grow.
quests.done: The first branch buds: briefs with a target, a check, and a plan before the edits.

quests.title: Plan Before You Edit
quests.story: A surveyor walks the branch before the axe swings. A wrong cut on paper costs a line; a wrong cut on the tree costs the branch.
quests.done: You ask for a plan, read it like a reviewer, and know what a plan does and does not guarantee.

quests.title: The Project Charter
quests.story: A carved stone stands at the forest's heart, holding what every traveller should know. It advises. It cannot bind.
quests.done: A second branch: standing instructions that help, and a clear sense of why they do not enforce.

quests.title: Forge a Skill
quests.story: In a hollow, a smith keeps procedures in folders, taking each out only when it is needed.
quests.done: A third branch: a procedure packaged as a Skill, installed and confirmed loaded.

quests.title: Close the Loop
quests.story: A hunter's log hangs from a branch: every time the machine went astray, a note of what was asked and what went wrong.
quests.done: A fourth branch: each failure becomes a Skill, and each Skill is measured with and without.

quests.title: Test the Skill
quests.story: The smith holds the Skill up against an empty hand. Only if the two differ does it stay.
quests.done: A fifth branch: you can read an eval, you know what it costs, and you know what a pass does not prove.

quests.title: Bundle a Plugin
quests.story: At the forest's edge, a satchel waits to be packed with the smith's finest Skills and tests. Whatever you carry, others will unpack.
quests.done: The satchel is packed and sealed, and you know that opening someone else's satchel means trusting what runs inside.

quests.title: Plug In a Server
quests.story: A heavy door in the Gatehouse opens onto the outside world. Anything that comes through acts with your keys.
quests.done: You treat an MCP server as software you install, and scope it, limit it and read what it sends back.

quests.title: Guard the Door
quests.story: A watchman stands at the door and checks every visitor against a list. The list is code, so no one can talk their way past.
quests.done: You can write a hook that refuses a command, and you know what it can and cannot stop.

quests.title: Advice or Enforcement
quests.story: A wall of signs hangs in the Gatehouse: some ask politely, some lock the door. You must know which is which.
quests.done: You sort every control by whether it advises, asks or enforces, and choose the right one for each risk.

quests.title: Send Small, Say So
quests.story: A Review-leech clings to the reef, feeding on work passed to others unchecked. Tidy hand-offs starve it.
quests.done: You hand over small, honest, evidenced work. The leech goes hungry.

quests.title: The Reviewer's Code
quests.story: Now the work comes to you. Ask for evidence, not for stories, and be kind about it.
quests.done: You review the work, not the tool, and you ask for what can be checked.

quests.title: Teach and Share the Load
quests.story: A reef thrives on many hands. Teach what you know, protect what you are learning, and take on only what you can review.
quests.done: You teach the checks, guard your own learning, and keep your workload reviewable.

quests.title: Dry Run First
quests.story: Conveyor belts hum, but one is wired to nowhere. A cheap test run shows where each belt leads before any real cargo moves.
quests.done: You check the wiring cheaply, layer by layer, before the real cargo rolls.

quests.title: Same Every Time
quests.story: A talkative machine sits in the middle of the line. Sometimes it says one thing, sometimes another. The factory needs the same every time.
quests.done: You keep the talker out of the run, or fence it in with records, caches and checks.

quests.title: Read the Rails
quests.story: The rails look sound, but one points at a private road and another melts the cargo it carries.
quests.done: You read the rails for hidden paths, undeclared outputs and overwritten inputs.

quests.title: Why Notebooks Diff Badly
quests.story: Scribes here keep notebooks, but every page is stuffed with outputs and images. Reviewing a change means wading through all of it.
quests.done: You know why a notebook review is hard, and how to make the changes visible.

quests.title: Run It Top to Bottom
quests.story: A notebook can hold a result nobody can reproduce. The order of work matters more than the page.
quests.done: You check a notebook by running it fresh from top to bottom, and you review the code, not the outputs.

quests.title: Login Node Manners
quests.story: The Citadel gate is shared by hundreds. One careless sweep of the whole library slows everyone.
quests.done: You keep heavy work off the login node and off shared storage, and you know what to hand to the scheduler.

quests.title: Jobs, Not Jam
quests.story: A queue master hands out places in line. An agent that submits jobs freely can fill every place.
quests.done: You let the agent draft job scripts, and you keep submitting and cancelling under your own approval.

quests.title: Keys on Shared Ground
quests.story: Your home directory lies on ground that others can reach. Keys, tokens and agent settings do not belong in a shared place.
quests.done: Keys stay private, data stays within its agreement, and you ask your cluster staff before you use an agent there.

quests.title: Boss: Clear the Murk
quests.story: At the centre of the land the Murk has gathered into one dark knot. The Murk is every unchecked answer you met on the way, pressed together.
quests.done: The Murk thins and lifts. You carry the habits that keep the Blight from spreading: a way back, firm rules, independent checks and honest hand-offs.

codon-mill-too-many-tools-too-many-agent.title: Too Many Tools, Too Many Agents

branches.name: Memory and sessions
branches.who: Anyone whose sessions run long or get confused, and who wants to keep work from being lost.
branches.blurb: Keep long sessions clear, and carry work across the gap between them.

branches.name: Skills and plugins
branches.who: People who repeat the same agent tasks and want to package and test them.
branches.blurb: Turn repeated work into tested Skills and plugins.

branches.name: Guards
branches.who: Anyone connecting tools (MCP) or wanting hard rules instead of advice.
branches.blurb: Connect tools safely and enforce rules in code, not advice.

branches.name: Craft
branches.who: Pipeline authors (Nextflow, Snakemake) using an agent on workflow code.
branches.blurb: Use agents on pipeline code without losing reproducibility.

branches.name: Notebooks
branches.who: Jupyter and R Markdown users who review analysis in notebooks.
branches.blurb: Review and re-run notebooks so results can be trusted.

branches.name: Shared ground
branches.blurb: Work with agents on a shared cluster without harming others or leaking keys.

branches.name: People
branches.who: Anyone collaborating, reviewing others' work or teaching a group.
branches.blurb: Hand over, review and teach work involving agents, kindly and honestly.

branches.name: Companions and cloud
branches.who: People choosing models and effort, or considering cloud sessions.
branches.blurb: Choose models and effort per job, and decide what may go to the cloud.
